apiMessages.content: My quads are wrecked from Sunday’s leg day — sore going down stairs, nothing sharp and nothing in the joints. Should I still do tomorrow’s upper session?

Yes — DOMS without joint/sharp pain is a training input, not an injury signal. Upper Strength doesn't load the quads, so go ahead as planned Tuesday.

Legs will loosen with movement; just keep normal warm-up and skip anything that turns sharp.
